summary: Evidence publication preserves git's configured remote URL, pushurl, transport and credential environment, including when an evidence token is supplied. st-test logs the child evidence-wrap argv. Publication guidance uses head-scoped explicit refs in bounded batches rather than the cached evidence namespace.

replay.detail: Script-only publication changes; no event replay or intermediate daemon version transitions.

schema.detail: No database, checkpoint or signed evidence format changes.

rules.detail: No fleet coordination, accepted-key or evidence admission rules change.

compatibility.detail: Existing evidence records and all readers remain compatible. Only the git push environment and diagnostic output change.

downtime.detail: No running service needs a restart.

manual.detail: Existing remote and credential configuration is honored automatically by the updated scripts. No state migration is required.

recovery.detail: Existing evidence refs are never rewritten or deleted; reverting requires no state repair.
